dimensions.assessment: Affects 26 commission members, federal agency consultants, and stakeholders in insurance and emergency management.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall be composed of-- (1) 8 members... (2) 8 members... (3) 8 members... and (4) 2 members who shall be State insurance commissioners

dimensions.assessment: Effects are limited to administrative review, public hearings, and producing a report with legislative recommendations.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall examine the risks posed to the United States... and submit... a report that contains-- (1) a detailed statement of the findings

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes unspecified appropriations to carry out the Act, with members serving without pay.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Commission such sums as may be necessary to carry out this Act

dimensions.assessment: Creates a temporary independent federal commission that terminates 90 days after submitting its report.
dimensions.evidence: There is established an independent, nonpartisan Commission on Natural Disaster Risk Management and Insurance

dimensions.assessment: Temporary duration; the commission terminates 90 days after reporting, which is required not later than 2 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall terminate 90 days after the date on which the Commission submits the report under section 5.

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts authorized for appropriations are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a temporary nonpartisan commission to examine natural disaster risk management and insurance. The commission relies on existing information and volunteer members, resulting in a limited administrative and advisory impact.
